articles.headline: Jets rookie WR Omar Cooper Jr. put on IR with sprained ankle
articles.description: Jets rookie wide receiver Omar Cooper Jr., one of the team's three first-round picks, has been placed on injured reserve with a sprained ankle.
articles.headlineJa: ジェッツのルーキーWRオマール・クーパー・ジュニア、足首の捻挫でIR入り
articles.descriptionJa: ジェッツのドラフト1巡目指名選手3人のうちの1人であるルーキーワイドレシーバーのオマール・クーパー・ジュニアが、足首の捻挫により故障者リスト（IR）に登録されました。
articles.body:
FLORHAM PARK, N.J. -- New York Jets rookie wide receiver Omar Cooper Jr., one of the team's three first-round picks, was placed on injured reserve Saturday with a sprained ankle.

Cooper, who played only four snaps in the Week 1 win over the Tennessee Titans, is expected to return after his four-week IR stint. He is eligible to play Oct. 18 against the New England Patriots.

The Jets now have two wide receivers on injured reserve -- Cooper and Tim Patrick -- leaving them with only four receivers on the active roster for Sunday's game against the Green Bay Packers at MetLife Stadium.

Chances are the Jets (1-0) will lean heavily on their tight ends in the game plan. They have five on the roster and actually used all five on one play in the 23-10 win over the Titans.

Cooper, drafted 30th overall out of Indiana, made a quick impact in his debut. On the opening possession, he caught a short pass, broke several tackles and turned it into a 30-yard play, setting up a touchdown. After that, he left the game.

He didn't practice all week and was ruled out Friday.

Beyond starters Garrett Wilson and Adonai Mitchell, the Jets have Isaiah Williams and Arian Smith at wide receiver. Williams and Smith were targeted only once apiece last week, with Smith dropping his only chance.

For depth purposes, the Jets signed veterans Sterling Shepard and Tyler Johnson this week to the practice squad, but neither is expected to be elevated for Sunday's game.

articles.descriptionJa: キックオフに向けて発表された最新のレポートや公式発表に基づく、更新された欠場者情報と分析。
articles.body:
Whom should you start? Whom should you sit? To help you set your fantasy football lineups and avoid starting an offensive player who won't be in the lineup, we'll post fantasy-relevant updates and analysis here as NFL teams release their official inactives lists. 

Official Sunday inactives should begin coming in approximately 90 minutes before the scheduled kickoff times: around 11:30 a.m. ET for the early games and 2:30 p.m. ET for the late-afternoon games.

Refresh often for the latest information.

Don't forget to check these out: Mike Clay's Playbook | Week 2 Buzz 

Week 2 Rankings | Matchup rankings for Week 2

Biggest concerns heading into Week 2

Players with early starts

Joe Burrow, QB, Bengals (back): Burrow is dealing with back soreness and is listed as questionable but is expected to start. The quarterback stated that it would be "ridiculous" if the injury caused him to miss Week 2. Even in a tough matchup like the Texans, Burrow is a fantasy QB1.

If you want to avoid the matchup, Jaxson Dart and Brock Purdy are realistic options that a fantasy manager could have backing up Burrow. If you're skittish, those two could be started over him. However, for most of you, the choice should be to ride with Burrow.

TreVeyon Henderson, RB, Patriots (ankle): After missing the Patriots' opener because of an ankle injury, Henderson returned to practice this week and says he is "ready to go" for Week 2. Henderson will share work in the backfield with Rhamondre Stevenson. However, he is the more explosive option and therefore brings more fantasy upside.

Henderson can be played over Quinshon Judkins, MarShawn Lloyd, Tony Pollard, J.K. Dobbins, Rico Dowdle, Blake Corum, Kenny Gainwell and Jonathon Brooks.

Jalen Coker, WR, Panthers (ankle): After a huge Week 1 performance, Coker was limited in practice to start the week because of an ankle injury. He was able to log a full practice Friday and was removed from the injury report, meaning he will play in Week 2. While the Panthers will not often have "scorefests" like they did in Week 1, Coker's usage jumps off the screen. He saw nine targets -- three of the deep variety -- and finished with 138 yards and a touchdown, while narrowly missing a second score.

Coker is a high upside WR3. You can feel comfortable playing him over DK Metcalf, Michael Pittman Jr, Alec Pierce, Marvin Harrison Jr and Chris Godwin Jr.

Alvin Kamara, RB, Saints (knee): Kamara has "moved well" at practice and Kellen Moore has said he should play this week. He is a flex option that brings some PPR upside, but also some risk as we do not know how much work he will see. If he plays, it would be a bit of a thorn in the side of Travis Etienne Jr., who saw nine targets in Week 1.

articles.headline: Ravens' Zay Flowers downgraded to out because of hamstring injury
articles.description: The Baltimore Ravens downgraded Pro Bowl wide receiver Zay Flowers to out for Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints.
articles.headlineJa: レイブンズのゼイ・フラワーズ、ハムストリング負傷で欠場へダウングレード
articles.descriptionJa: ボルティモア・レイブンズは、日曜日のニューオーリンズ・セインツ戦に向けて、プロボウル選出のワイドレシーバー、ゼイ・フラワーズのステータスを欠場（out）にダウングレードしました。
articles.body:
OWINGS MILLS, Md. -- The Baltimore Ravens downgraded Pro Bowl wide receiver Zay Flowers to out for Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints, which means quarterback Lamar Jackson will be without one of his most valuable playmakers.

Flowers, the Ravens' No. 1 receiver, aggravated his left hamstring injury in Sunday's season opening 41-23 win at the Indianapolis Colts. He missed the first two practices of the week before being a limited participant on Friday.

The Ravens had listed Flowers as doubtful on Friday before officially scratching him on Saturday. This is the fourth game that Flowers will miss in his four-year career and his first since the 2024 AFC divisional playoff game at Buffalo.

The loss of Flowers is a significant one for Jackson and Baltimore. Over the last 18 games, Flowers has 91 catches for 1,361 yards. During that same stretch, the Ravens' other wide receivers have combined for 55 catches for 814 yards.

With Flowers ruled out and Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) on injured reserve, the Ravens will be without two of their top three wide receivers.

Rashod Bateman now becomes the receiver with the most familiarity with Jackson. The other four healthy wide receivers are LaJohntay Wester, Devontez Walker, Elijah Sarratt and Chris Moore.

Earlier in the week, Ravens coach Jesse Minter said his advice to the healthy receivers is "run at the opportunity."

"I think the first game was a great example that the ball can really go anywhere in our offense," Minter said. "Just being very precise, being very detailed, being in the right spot, the ball can find you. Playing fast and playing with confidence, we have a lot of confidence in all those guys."

In addition to downgrading Flowers, the Ravens placed top backup cornerback T.J. Tampa (knee) on injured reserve and signed practice squad linebacker Carl Jones to the 53-man roster.

Baltimore elevated offensive tackle Gerad Lichtenhan from the practice squad. The addition of an extra offensive tackle could indicate that left tackle Ronnie Stanley (questionable, toe) may not play.

Stanley has been sidelined for 45 games in his 10 seasons, but only one of those games was within the past two seasons. If he can't play, Carson Vinson get his first career start.

articles.headline: Orioles activate ex-closer Félix Bautista; Trey Mancini retires
articles.description: The Orioles activated reliever Félix Bautista after a 14-month absence following shoulder surgery. In addition, Trey Mancini signed a one-day deal and has retired.
articles.headlineJa: オリオールズが元守護神フェリックス・バティスタを復帰登録、トレイ・マンシーニは現役引退
articles.descriptionJa: オリオールズは、肩の手術を経て14か月ぶりにリリーフのフェリックス・バティスタをアクティブ登録しました。また、トレイ・マンシーニは1日契約を結んだ上で現役を引退しました。
articles.body:
BALTIMORE -- The Orioles activated reliever Felix Bautista from the 60-day injured list Saturday, setting up the former closer to return from right shoulder surgery 14 months after his last major league game.

Bautista saved 33 games and struck out 110 in 61 innings while earning an All-Star nod in 2023, but he missed the final month of that season and all of 2024 while recovering from Tommy John surgery. He had 19 saves in 35 games in 2025 before surgery to repair his torn labrum and torn rotator cuff ended his season.

Bautista had a 2.35 ERA in nine minor league rehab games.

"He is as close to full go as he could be," manager Craig Albernaz said. "We're going to try to be as smart as we can with using Félix. But also, the game is chaotic and unpredictable, so you don't know what's going to happen."

The Orioles also optioned pitcher Cade Povich and outfielder Heston Kjerstad to Triple-A Norfolk, activated outfielder Christian Franklin from the 10-day injured list and transferred outfielder Tyler O'Neill to the 60-day IL.

Mike Elias, Baltimore's president of baseball operations, said Saturday that Albernaz would return in 2027. The Orioles are 75-79 in Albernaz's first season and began the day three games out of an American League wild-card spot.

"It's a great vote of confidence," Albernaz said. "Obviously, this season hasn't gone the way I wanted it by any stretch, by how the players wanted the season to go, how the front office, how the fanbase. ... That's something I wear pretty heavily because of the seat I'm in and I don't take that lightly."

In addition, Trey Mancini signed a one-day contract to retire with the Orioles, the franchise he played for during the bulk of his eight-year career in the majors.

The former first baseman and outfielder had four 20-homer seasons for Baltimore. He also was an emotional centerpiece of the Orioles after he recovered from a colon cancer diagnosis that cost him the entire 2020 season. He earned the AL's Comeback Player of the Year Award in 2021, hitting .255 with 21 homers and 71 RBIs.

"I know there have been players that were better players than me overall and that haven't gotten this treatment and haven't gotten to retire with the team they came up with and played with for a long time and really identified with," said Mancini, who was honored before the Orioles' game against the Milwaukee Brewers. "It's not something I take for granted at all."

Mancini hit .263 with 129 homers and 404 RBIs in the majors, making 701 of his 836 appearances with the Orioles.

Mancini was dealt to Houston at the trade deadline in 2022 and helped the Astros win the World Series. He struggled in 79 games with the Chicago Cubs in 2023, spent the following year out of baseball and then played the first three months of the 2025 season with Reno, Arizona's Triple-A team.

Mancini hit .308 in five games with the Los Angeles Angels in June, then announced his retirement on Aug. 18.

articles.headline: Sean Burke and Miguel Vargas help the White Sox beat the Tigers 3-1
articles.description: — Sean Burke pitched six effective innings, Miguel Vargas homered and the Chicago White Sox topped the Detroit Tigers 3-1 on Saturday for a sorely needed victory.
articles.headlineJa: ショーン・バークとミゲル・バルガスが貢献、ホワイトソックスがタイガースを3-1で破る
articles.descriptionJa: ショーン・バークが6回を効果的に抑え、ミゲル・バルガスが本塁打を放ち、シカゴ・ホワイトソックスが土曜日にデトロイト・タイガースを3-1で下し、喉から手が出るほど欲しかった勝利を手にしました。
articles.body:
CHICAGO -- — Sean Burke pitched six effective innings, Miguel Vargas homered and the Chicago White Sox topped the Detroit Tigers 3-1 on Saturday for a sorely needed victory.


              Chicago dropped into second in the AL Central after it blew a six-run lead in an 11-8 loss to Detroit on Friday night. Heading into Saturday’s action, the White Sox were one game behind Cleveland in the division and third in the wild-card standings, one game better than Texas.


              The White Sox (79-76) dropped at least 101 games in each of the last three years. They could become the first big league team to make the playoffs after finishing with at least 100 losses in each of the previous two seasons.


              Burke (10-7) allowed one run and five hits in his second straight win. Grant Taylor got four outs for his 10th save.


              Detroit (73-82) left 11 runners on base in its third loss in four games. Jackson Jobe (2-3) struck out nine while surrendering three runs in six innings.


              Trailing 2-1, the Tigers loaded the bases with two down in the sixth. Riley Greene scampered home on a wild pitch to Brett Callahan but video review determined the ball hit Callahan after he swung and missed, and Greene was sent back to third.


              Callahan then struck out looking, ending the inning, and Vargas led off the bottom half with a 390-foot drive to left-center for his 33rd homer.


              Taylor replaced Noah Schultz with two on in the eighth. The right-hander retired pinch-hitter Eduardo Valencia on a bouncer to first, ending the inning.


              The start time was moved to the afternoon because of thunderstorms forecasted for Saturday night.


              Chicago played without outfielder Tristan Peters, who was sore a day after crashing into the wall in right-center while trying to make a play on Kevin McGonigle’s triple in the fifth inning.


              Up next
              Troy Melton (8-4, 2.52 ERA) starts for Detroit on Sunday, and fellow right-hander Davis Martin (9-7, 3.96 ERA) pitches for Chicago in the finale of the four-game series.

articles.headline: NFL changes rules governing videoboard displays during kicks
articles.description: The NFL has modified what can be shown on videoboards during field goal and extra point attempts, an alteration coming in the wake of a viral social media post from a former analytics coach.
articles.headlineJa: NFL、キック時の大型映像装置の表示ルールを変更
articles.descriptionJa: NFLは、フィールドゴールおよびポイント・アフター・タッチダウンの試行中に大型映像装置に表示できる内容を変更しました。このルール変更は、元アナリティクスコーチによるSNSでの拡散投稿を受けて行われました。
articles.body:
FOXBOROUGH, Mass. -- The NFL recently informed teams that the league has modified what can be shown on videoboards during field goal and extra point attempts, an alteration coming in the wake of a viral social media post from a former analytics coach.

The NFL has long required all videoboards and ribbon boards to display a static image -- no flashing images, blinking effects, moving text/images etc. -- or an All-22 view, such as the high-sideline or high-end-zone angle, during kicks.

What has now changed, according to a memo obtained by ESPN that was sent to all clubs Sept. 7, is that teams must use the same All-22 angle or static image for both kicking teams. The modification is designed to ensure competitive equity. Teams were warned that violations will result in discipline.

Ryan Paganetti, a former analytics coach with the Philadelphia Eagles, Jacksonville Jaguars and Las Vegas Raiders, posted on X that he had studied a decade of New England Patriots television broadcasts when Bill Belichick was head coach from 2000 to 2023.

Paganetti's Sept. 1 social media post said he discovered that when opposing kickers prepared for an attempt, the videoboard displayed a reverse All-22 view of the kick. The result was a second set of offset goalposts shown on the videoboard, creating an optical illusion for opposing kickers.

Paganetti added that of the 52 kicks he studied that were attempted by the Patriots, the reverse All-22 view of the kick was never shown on the videoboard. Paganetti's post on X had nearly 17 million views this weekend.

The Patriots were operating within the rules during that time, according to the NFL. Other teams with videoboards behind uprights were experimenting with various things that were also within the rules.

But now that the league is requiring clubs to use the same All-22 angle or static image for both kicking teams, that practice would no longer be allowed.

articles.headline: Rams' Puka Nacua again misses practice, questionable for MNF
articles.description: Rams receiver Puka Nacua will not practice for the second day in a row and will be listed as questionable for Monday night's game against the Giants.
articles.headlineJa: ラムズのプカ・ナクアが再び練習を欠席、MNFへの出場は微妙
articles.descriptionJa: ラムズのレシーバー、プカ・ナクアは2日連続で練習を欠席し、月曜夜のジャイアンツ戦への出場ステータスはクエスチョナブル（出場微妙）と指定されます。
articles.body:
Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua will not practice for the second day in a row due to "a little bit of soreness" in his groin and will be listed as questionable for Monday night's game against the New York Giants, coach Sean McVay said.

"[We are] being smart with him as a skill player," McVay said Saturday. "Whether or not he plays is to be determined. And so we'll see how he's feeling, but he won't practice [Saturday]."

McVay said Nacua's injury is separate from the psoas injury that caused him to miss time during training camp.

Nacua practiced Thursday, McVay said, but he "didn't feel totally like himself [with] his ability to be able to kind of open up and really hit full speed." He was listed on the injury report Friday with a hip injury.

Nacua could have a favorable matchup if he plays. Giants starting cornerback Deonte Banks didn't practice Saturday for the second consecutive day with a calf injury and is listed as questionable.

New York could be extremely shorthanded at cornerback. While it doesn't look good for Banks, Paulson Adebo (knee) was also placed on injured reserve earlier this week. This presumably has rookie Colton Hood in line to start at cornerback opposite Greg Newsome. It would be a tough spot for Hood vs. the accomplished Nacua and Davante Adams.

McVay also said wide receiver Jordan Whittington, who was added to the injury report Friday, will be listed as doubtful for the game with a quad injury.

The Rams are expecting Aaron Donald to play Monday night in what would be his first game since coming out of retirement after two seasons. When asked Friday if he would play, Donald said "that's the plan."

"If he said it, he's going," McVay said Saturday. "Whatever Aaron says, I support him."

articles.headline: Premier League VAR review: Was Rice lucky not to be sent off at Brighton?
articles.description: VAR often causes controversy, but how are decisions made? Our resident ref, Andy Davies, explains all.
articles.headlineJa: プレミアリーグVAR検証：ライスはブライトン戦で退場を免れて幸運だったのか？
articles.descriptionJa: VARはしばしば物議を醸しますが、判定はどのように下されているのでしょうか？専属審判のアンディ・デイヴィスが詳しく解説します。
articles.body:
The video assistant referee causes controversy every week, whether it be the Premier League, Champions League or FA Cup, but how are those decisions made and are they correct?

For the 2026-27 season, we are taking a look at the major incidents to explain the process in terms of both VAR protocol and the laws of the game. The most surprising, controversial and complicated decisions will be examined all season long right here.

 Andy Davies (@andydaviesref) is a former Select Group referee, with over 12 seasons on the elite list, working across the Premier League and Championship. With extensive experience at the elite level, he has operated within the VAR space in the Premier League and offers a unique insight into the processes, rationale and protocols that are delivered on a matchday. 

Was Rice lucky not to be sent off at Brighton?

Brighton & Hove Albion 3-0 Arsenal (Sept. 19)

Referee: Darren England

VAR: Tim Wood

Time: 90+7 minutes

Incident: Possible red card for Arsenal's Declan Rice

What happened: Rice picked up a late yellow card when he appeared to kick out at Brighton's Malick Yalcouyé in an off-the-ball incident.

VAR decision: The on-field decision of yellow card was checked and cleared as correct by the VAR.

In these types of situations, VAR involvement can only be triggered if they believe the on-field refereeing team have missed a violent act or an act or brutality. VAR was comfortable that the action by Rice did not meet either threshold, therefore the check was a straightforward one.

Verdict: This frustrated act by Rice was picked up in real time by the fourth official and certainly high risk, when considering many off-the-ball, non-footballing offenses are often interpreted as a red-card offense by referees and matched by the expectations of football, so Rice can consider himself fortunate. However, I am comfortable that this action in isolation was a frustrated and petulant attempt at a trip on Yalcouyé and not a violent or act of brutality, therefore a yellow card feels like a correct and sensible outcome.

VAR would never get involved in this situation unless there was clear evidence that the on-field outcome was incorrect, so the yellow card was correctly checked and cleared. Rice is very fortunate that the original on-field interpretation of his action was only a yellow card, otherwise he would be serving a three-game ban following the international break.

Why was Phil Foden sent off? And why was Enzo Fernández not ruled offside in Manchester derby?

Manchester United 0-1 Manchester City (Sept. 13)

Referee: Michael Oliver

VAR: Matt Donohue

Time: 23rd minute

Incident: Red card for Phil Foden of Manchester City

What happened: City's Foden appeared to kick out at United's Bruno Fernandes following an untidy tangle between the two players.
